name: Repel Calamity
description: Destroy target creature with power or toughness 4 or greater.
couldNotDerive: The power/toughness >=4 restriction (ValidTgts$ is a comma-OR of two stat-threshold qualifiers, not represented).
notes: ValidTgts$ Creature.powerGE4,Creature.toughnessGE4 ("power OR toughness 4 or greater") is a real, unrepresented restriction -- qualifierFlags has no support for stat-threshold qualifiers at all (distinct from the narrower ConditionDefined$Targeted+ConditionPresent$ shape already handled for Driftgloom Coyote, which is a condition on an EARLIER target, not the primary ValidTgts$ predicate itself). Not fixed this round -- would need a general power/toughness-threshold qualifier convention, plus OR support (this card ORs two different stats), which qualifierFlags' current design (an array of independent AND'd facts) doesn't cleanly support.
